title: Supreme Court: Roman Catholic Diocese of Brooklyn v. Cuomo
summary: Respondent is enjoined from enforcing Executive Order 202.68’s 10- and 25-person occupancy limits on Applicant pending disposition of the appeal in the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit and disposition of the petition for a writ of certiorari, if such writ is timely sought. (No. 20A87, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 592 U.S. 14).

title: Supreme Court: Taylor v. Riojas
summary: Because any reasonable correctional officer should have realized that inmate Taylor’s conditions of confinement offended the Eighth Amendment, the Fifth Circuit erred in granting the officers qualified immunity. (No. 19-1261, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 592 U.S. 7).

title: Supreme Court: Mckesson v. Doe
summary: Under the unusual circumstances of this case, the Fifth Circuit should not have ventured into such an uncertain area of state tort law without first using state certification procedures to seek guidance from the Louisiana Supreme Court. (No. 19-1108, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 592 U.S. 1).
